place.name: San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: Mission Concepcion
features.description: Mission Concepcion is the northernmost park mission, known for unrestored stone architecture and original frescoes, with a contact station and accessible parking.

details.positionQuality: Mission Concepcion, Felisa Street, San Antonio, Bexar County, Texas, 78210, United States
details.imageAlt: Mission Concepcion at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: Mission San Jose
features.description: Mission San Jose is the largest mission and park orientation center, with visitor center, film, store, ranger walks, compound, church, gristmill, and restrooms.

details.positionQuality: Mission San José, San Jose Drive, San Antonio, Bexar County, Texas, 78214, United States
details.imageAlt: Mission San Jose at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: Mission San Juan Capistrano
features.description: Mission San Juan includes a church, farm fields, acequia, contact station, picnic area, restrooms, and access to the short nature trail.

details.positionQuality: Mission San Juan Capistrano, Yanaguana Trail, Berg's Mill, San Antonio, Bexar County, Texas, 78235, United States
details.imageAlt: Mission San Juan Capistrano at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: Mission Espada
features.description: Mission Espada is the southernmost mission, with a compact compound, museum/contact station, active church, acequia landscape, and nearby aqueduct.

details.positionQuality: Mission San Francisco de la Espada, River Walk, San Antonio, Bexar County, Texas, 78235, United States
details.imageAlt: Mission Espada at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: Mission Reach Trail
features.description: The Mission Reach trail links downtown and the four missions for walking and biking over a long daylight-only river corridor with many trailheads.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed Mission Reach trail reference point near Mission San Jose
details.coordinateSource: OpenStreetMap and AuditMap review of the official NPS map
details.imageAlt: Mission Reach Trail at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: Espada Aqueduct
features.description: The historic Espada Aqueduct is a fragile self-guided site with a small lot and benches but no restrooms, drinking water, or climbing access.

details.positionQuality: Mission San Francisco de la Espada Dam, Ditch and Aqueduct, Ashley Road, San Antonio, Bexar County, Texas, 78235, United States
details.imageAlt: Espada Aqueduct at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: Mission San Jose Visitor Center
features.description: The Mission San Jose Visitor Center is the best first stop for maps, Junior Ranger books, orientation film, ranger guidance, accessible restrooms, and park store.

details.positionQuality: Mission San Jose Visitor Center, 6701 San Jose Drive
details.coordinateSource: AuditMap review of National Park Service directions and site map
details.imageAlt: Mission San Jose Visitor Center at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park

features.name: San Juan Nature Trail
features.description: San Juan Nature Trail is a short sunrise-to-sunset route through river and mission landscape that can close for mud, flooding, heat, or habitat work.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed San Juan Nature Trail beside Mission San Juan
details.coordinateSource: AuditMap review of the National Park Service Mission San Juan map
details.imageAlt: San Juan Nature Trail at San Antonio Missions National Historical Park
